switches.name: Tower Bridge open
switches.description: ON while the bascules are up for river traffic. Flash a lamp or pause the garden when a ship is passing. Lift times: towerbridge.org.uk.
switches.onMeans: The roadway is open to shipping.
switches.offMeans: The bridge is down for road traffic.

switches.name: Erasmusbrug open
switches.description: ON while Rotterdam's swan bridge is open to shipping. Pair it with a harbour scene or a porch light. Opening times come from the Port of Rotterdam.
switches.onMeans: The span is open to ships.
switches.offMeans: The span is closed for road traffic.

switches.name: UK Commons sitting
switches.description: ON while the House of Commons is sitting. Useful for a quiet-house scene or a Westminster lamp. The calendar is on parliament.uk.
switches.onMeans: The Commons is in session.
switches.offMeans: The House is adjourned or in recess.

switches.name: US Congress in session
switches.description: ON while the United States Congress is in session. A simple remote for Capitol-watching automations. Schedule: congress.gov.
switches.onMeans: Congress is in session.
switches.offMeans: Congress is adjourned.

switches.name: UK Prime Minister: Andy Burnham
switches.description: ON while Andy Burnham is Prime Minister. It turns off when the office-holder changes, then the listing is renamed. Source: Wikidata / GOV.UK.
switches.onMeans: Andy Burnham currently holds the office.
switches.offMeans: Someone else is Prime Minister, or the office is vacant.

switches.name: US President: Donald Trump
switches.description: ON while Donald Trump is President of the United States. It turns off on a change of office-holder, then the listing is renamed. Source: Wikidata.
switches.onMeans: Donald Trump currently holds the office.
switches.offMeans: Someone else is President, or the office is vacant.

switches.name: Pope: Leo XIV
switches.description: ON while Leo XIV is Pope. It turns off during a sede vacante or a new pontificate. Pair with the conclave switch for the gap in between.
switches.onMeans: Leo XIV is the reigning Pope.
switches.offMeans: The Holy See is vacant, or another Pope has been elected.

switches.name: Papal conclave
switches.description: ON while a papal conclave is sitting to elect a Pope. A rare, large event. Subscribe now; it will almost always be off.
switches.onMeans: Cardinals are in conclave.
switches.offMeans: No conclave is in progress.

switches.name: UK general election called
switches.description: ON from the moment a UK general election is called until polls close. Unpredictable on purpose. Use it for a campaign scene or a reminder lamp.
switches.onMeans: A general election has been called and voting has not finished.
switches.offMeans: No UK general election is under way.

switches.name: Geomagnetic storm G4+
switches.description: ON during a severe or extreme geomagnetic storm (G4 or G5). Aurora watchers can light a room; radio users can pause. Based on NOAA space-weather alerts.
switches.onMeans: A G4 or G5 geomagnetic storm is in progress.
switches.offMeans: No severe storm is current.

switches.name: Christmas Day
switches.description: ON on 25 December UTC. A community switch for Christmas lights that should agree with everyone else's. Local midnight will differ; this is the UTC civil day.
switches.onMeans: It is 25 December, UTC.
switches.offMeans: It is any other UTC day.

switches.name: Easter Sunday (Western)
switches.description: ON on Western Easter Sunday, UTC. 2026 is 5 April; 2027 is 28 March. Use it for a dawn scene or to rest an automation for the day.
switches.onMeans: It is Western Easter Sunday, UTC.
switches.offMeans: It is not Western Easter Sunday.

switches.name: Ramadan
switches.description: ON for the month of Ramadan, using calculated UTC dates (local moon-sighting can differ by a day). 2026: 18 February to 19 March. A community switch for iftar lamps.
switches.onMeans: The calculated month of Ramadan is under way.
switches.offMeans: It is not Ramadan on the calculated calendar.

switches.name: Eid al-Fitr
switches.description: ON on Eid al-Fitr, using calculated UTC dates. 2026 is 20–21 March. Local moon-sighting can move it by a day. A feast-day switch for lights and greetings.
switches.onMeans: It is Eid al-Fitr on the calculated calendar.
switches.offMeans: It is not Eid al-Fitr.

switches.name: Diwali
switches.description: ON on Diwali (Lakshmi Puja), UTC. 2026 is 8 November; 2027 is 29 October. The natural switch for a house of lamps.
switches.onMeans: It is Diwali, UTC.
switches.offMeans: It is not Diwali.

switches.name: Hanukkah
switches.description: ON for the eight days of Hanukkah. 2026 begins at sundown on 4 December. A menorah automation that stays in step with the calendar.
switches.onMeans: Hanukkah is being observed.
switches.offMeans: It is not Hanukkah.

switches.name: Yom Kippur
switches.description: ON for Yom Kippur, from sundown on the eve through the following day. 2026 is 20–21 September. A pause switch: rest noisy automations for the fast.
switches.onMeans: Yom Kippur is being observed.
switches.offMeans: It is not Yom Kippur.

switches.name: Lunar New Year
switches.description: ON on Lunar New Year's Day, UTC. 2026 is 17 February (Year of the Horse); 2027 is 6 February. Red lanterns, optional firecrackers, optional restraint.
switches.onMeans: It is Lunar New Year's Day, UTC.
switches.offMeans: It is not Lunar New Year's Day.

switches.name: Earth Hour
switches.description: ON on Earth Hour Saturday (last Saturday of March, UTC civil day). Officially 20:30–21:30 local; this listing covers the UTC day so every timezone can join.
switches.onMeans: It is Earth Hour Saturday, UTC.
switches.offMeans: It is not Earth Hour Saturday.

switches.name: New Year (UTC)
switches.description: ON from 21:00 UTC on 31 December until 06:00 UTC on 1 January. A worldwide midnight switch. Local new year will not match; that is the point of the UTC version.
switches.onMeans: UTC new year is in the window.
switches.offMeans: It is not around UTC midnight on 1 January.

switches.name: Pride Month
switches.description: ON throughout June, UTC. A community switch for rainbow lighting. Pride events happen in other months too; this listing follows the widely used June observance.
switches.onMeans: It is June, UTC.
switches.offMeans: It is any other month.

switches.name: Full moon
switches.description: ON on the UTC calendar day of a full moon. Next in 2026: 26 September. A night-light or garden switch that follows the sky rather than a wall clock.
switches.onMeans: A full moon falls on this UTC date.
switches.offMeans: It is not a full-moon UTC date.

switches.name: Swedish election 2026
switches.description: ON while the 2026 riksdag election is unfinished: the count is still open, or parties have not yet formed a government. A reminder lamp through the overseas ballots and the talks that follow. Results: val.se.
switches.onMeans: The count is still preliminary, or no new government has taken office.
switches.offMeans: A new government has taken office after the 2026 election.

switches.name: Øresund Bridge open
switches.description: ON while Øresundsbron is open to road traffic between Malmö and Copenhagen. A crossing lamp for weather, incidents or maintenance. Traffic: oresundsbron.com.
switches.onMeans: The bridge is open to road traffic.
switches.offMeans: The crossing is closed or severely restricted.

switches.name: Great Belt Bridge open
switches.description: ON while Storebæltsbroen is open to road traffic across Denmark's Great Belt. Pair it with Øresund for the two main Danish straits. Traffic: sundogbaelt.dk.
switches.onMeans: The Great Belt Bridge is open to road traffic.
switches.offMeans: The crossing is closed or severely restricted.
